en_before: Streetwear is global. When traditional clothing details appear, study Wafuku garment construction separately rather than folding that clothing system into contemporary streetwear by default. Japanese streetwear is one contextual interpretation where imported American references, domestic labels, designer clothing and subcultures intersect. Harajuku Style is broader in a geographic and subcultural direction, encompassing systems that are not necessarily streetwear.
